run_instrumentation_benchmark: run the nevergrad instrumentation benchmark across multiple dimensions and array sizes
test_optimizer_with_timeout: test a nevergrad optimizer with a 30 second timeout using SIGALRM signal handling
create_continuous_array_domain: create a continuous multidimensional array domain using ng.p.Array with a given shape
create_discrete_array_domain: create a discrete boolean array domain using ng.p.Array with integer casting enabled
create_mixed_instrumentation_domain: create a mixed continuous and discrete domain using ng.p.Instrumentation with multiple parameters
